name: comp-302

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the whole banner untouched, with the cursor off the text and arrow.

tagline: A dark strip links to news with a sparkle emoji and a nudging arrow.
summary: A one-line dark announcement bar with a sparkle before the headline and a small arrow after it, all wrapped in a single link. Hovering nudges the arrow a little to the right.
appearance: A wide, low rounded rectangle in dark grey sits centred on the page. One line of small light text is centred inside, led by a yellow sparkle and closed by a small right arrow.
behaviour: The whole line is one link. Hovering it nudges the arrow slightly right; otherwise the strip is still, and nothing dismisses it.
search_phrases: announcement bar with sparkle and arrow
product update call to action bar
thin banner linking to an announcement
use_when: You want a one-line link to a new feature or news item above a page.
avoid_when: The copy is one fixed line with no close button, so it cannot be dismissed or lengthened.
customise: The headline, sparkle emoji and link target are written into the file; the banner accepts no props.
weight_why: One line of text and a tiny arrow transform that only runs on hover.

a11y.note: The link has no custom focus ring, and the sparkle emoji is read aloud while only the arrow is hidden from screen readers.

issues: No dismiss control, and the copy, emoji and link target are fixed in the source.
polish_why: Clean centred layout, but plain default styling and a barely visible hover nudge.
title: Dark Announcement Banner
